name: Archippus
overview: Archippus is a male figure mentioned in the New Testament, specifically noted for being reminded by the Apostle Paul to be diligent in the ministry he received from the Lord. There is no information about his tribe or additional personal notes, emphasizing his role in spiritual responsibility.
namesAndTitles: The name Archippus appears once in Scripture without a given meaning or special title. It is presented simply as a proper name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Archippus beyond what is noted in his unique attribute. No additional relational information is provided in the biblical account.
scriptureSignificance: Archippus holds significance as a recipient of a direct exhortation from Paul, highlighting the importance of faithfully carrying out the ministry entrusted to him by the Lord. This reminder underscores the responsibility of believers to persevere in their God-given service and reflects the early church's emphasis on steadfastness in ministry.
